title: The server disables password authentication
fault: The injection disables password authentication on the server.
prompts: Why did no password prompt appear?
Which authentication methods does the server offer?
hints: Run the command with -v, and read the Authentications that can continue line.
The server offered one method only, and your command carried no key.

reveal.wrong: The injection set PasswordAuthentication to no, and the command offered no key, so no path remains.
reveal.fix: Offer a key the server accepts, or re-enable the password method on the server if your policy allows it.
